tools.name: get_auction_bids
tools.description: Get a live or completed auction's bid history using its ID from search_auctions or search_live_auctions. Returns bidder names, bid amounts, and times where captured. Requires login and counts toward the plan allowance. Coverage varies by source.

tools.name: get_price_stats
tools.description: Get average, median, range, sell-through rate, and 12-month price trends for a canonical make and optional model/year range. Use for market summaries rather than individual sales. Requires login and a paid plan; counts toward the plan allowance.

tools.name: list_auction_bids
tools.description: Deprecated alias for get_auction_bids with the same parameters, results, and login requirement.

tools.name: list_live_auctions
tools.description: Deprecated alias for search_live_auctions with the same parameters, results, and login requirement.

tools.name: list_makes
tools.description: List available vehicle makes before searching auctions or classifieds. No login or metered request required.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List canonical models for a make from list_makes. Use these names in searches and price stats. No login or metered request required.

tools.name: search_auctions
tools.description: Search collector-car auction results and source links. Without login, returns up to five recent sold results using make/model filters. Sign in for full listing details, advanced filters, and pagination. Authenticated searches return completed auctions by default; status=coming soon opts into upcomin

tools.name: search_classifieds
tools.description: Search classified inventory and retained sale history. Requires login. Asking prices, price history, financing, and confirmed sold prices are separate in source currency. A confirmed missing advert may be gone; it does not establish a sale. Defaults to active inventory. Use status=all with changed_s

tools.name: search_live_auctions
tools.description: Search active auctions with current prices, ending times, mileage, bid counts, source links, and featured images. Use for auctions live now or ending soon. Requires login and counts toward the plan allowance. Coverage varies by source.
